messages:
Ava: quick check-in, prototyping a per-route KPI rollup that balances accuracy vs storage/compute. want opinions on window tiers + sampled raw capture.
Diego: what's the main problem we9re solving? noisy p99 on low-volume routes or the cost of scanning raw token traces?
Ava: both. cheap p99 scans over raw token traces blow up for many low-traffic routes. also KV-cache cold tails distort route KPIs.
Sam: two approaches: hierarchical rollups (multi-res windows) or heavy sampling (reservoir) + on-demand trace capture.
linda: FYI incremental rollups can mask fast regressions if windows are too big. need trigger hooks.
Ava: proposal: hot routes -> 1m rollups, mid -> 5m, cold -> 1h. keep small reservoir sample per route (1k tokens/day) with KV-hit/miss labels. trigger full capture if sampled p95 rises > 20%.
Diego: reservoir: how to store pointers to full traces? blob refs or trace-id pointers? we should avoid duplicating raw traces unless triggered.
Sam: store reservoir rows with compressed proto + pointer array to 3 representative full traces. on trigger, persist relevant raw traces for 24h.
linda: cardinality problem: route x region x model x kernel_choice will explode. enforce tag cardinality caps per route and roll low-traffic combos into "other".
Ava: agree. implementation detail: per-route tag cap = 1000 combos; add config to tune per-customer. Dedicated customers can opt-out.
ops-bot: scheduled feature flag rollout by Ava on 2024-06-10T14:30Z — flag: console.kpi_rollups.v1
Sam: metric payload shape thoughts: rollup rows should include p50/p95/p99 token latencies + token_count + a compact token-stack breakdown. recommend fixed-order array for stack to avoid map churn: [kernel_ms, kv_ms, batching_wait_ms, net_ms].
Ava: yep we'll emit breakdown as array. sample row example (json string in messages):

```
{
  "route":"chat.complete",
  "window_start":"2024-06-10T14:25:00Z",
  "p50_token_ms":"3.2",
  "p95_token_ms":"12.8",
  "p99_token_ms":"25.6",
  "token_count":"12000",
  "token_breakdown_ms":["8.5","2.1","1.0","0.6"]
}
```

Diego: alerts: two kinds — rollup alerts and sample-driven alerts. propose: sampled p95 delta > 15% sustained for 3 windows OR rollup p99 spike > 30% triggers page.
Sam: add an intermediate warning channel for sampled deltas so teams can triage before paging.
linda: UX: KPIs card should support mixed-resolution timelines and a toggle to overlay sampled raw points. mouseover shows token-stack waterfall for the selected window. add an annotation lane for kernel/quantization changes.
Ava: query sketch for rollup ingestion (pseudo SQL) — uses approximate percentiles and sums of per-token decomposition fields: 

```
INSERT INTO route_kpi_rollup
SELECT route, model_variant, floor(ts, '5m') as window,
  count(1) as token_count,
  approx_percentile(latency_token_ms, 50) as p50_token_ms,
  approx_percentile(latency_token_ms, 95) as p95_token_ms,
  approx_percentile(latency_token_ms, 99) as p99_token_ms,
  percentile_cont_array(sum_kernel_ms, sum_kv_ms, sum_wait_ms, sum_net_ms) as token_breakdown_ms
FROM token_trace
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7d'
GROUP BY route, model_variant, window;
```

Sam: note: percentile_cont_array is conceptual — we will emit breakdown as sums/means per window and reconstruct per-token pctiles by combining approx_percentiles with breakdown proportions if needed.
Diego: cost estimate? rollups should cut storage of raw traces by ~75-85% depending on retention. reservoir adds small overhead (~5%). overall net savings.
Ava: next steps: I'll ship PoC rollup job + reservoir writer. Sam will draft alert rules. Linda will mock compact KPI card and overlay controls.
linda: will post mocks by EOD Friday, include small/expanded card states.
Sam: I'll add the alert playbook and run a few simulated regressions to tune thresholds.
Ava: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the PoC link and a lightweight schema doc for the sample payloads.
Diego: thanks. :+1:
